malangdo,141,137,4	script	Costume Roulette	4_M_MERCAT2,{
	mes "[Costume Roulette]";
	mes "Mrrp~ Pick a costume part and I will spin that drawer for you, nya~";
	mes "One Silvervine Fruit buys one spin, nya.";
	mes "Pity: " + #COSTUME_ROULETTE_PITY + "/20";
	next;
	.@slot = select("Costume Head Top:Costume Head Mid:Costume Head Low / Mouth:Costume Garment:Leave") - 1;
	if (.@slot < 0 || .@slot >= 4) close;
	.@first_spin = 1;
L_Spin:
	.@count = getvariableofnpc(.SlotCount[.@slot], "costume_roulette_db");
	if (.@count <= 0) {
		mes "Mrr...? That drawer is empty, nya.";
		close;
	}
	if (countitem(6417) < 1) {
		mes "Mrrp... Bring me one Silvervine Fruit, nya~";
		close;
	}
	.@start = getvariableofnpc(.SlotStart[.@slot], "costume_roulette_db");
	.@id = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.Ids[0], "costume_roulette_db"), .@start + rand(.@count));
	if (!checkweight(.@id, 1) || !checkweight(7051, 1)) {
		mes "Mrr... Your bag is too full, nya. Make some room first, or I cannot promise the costume and pity gift.";
		close;
	}
	if (.@first_spin) {
		mes "Spend one Silvervine Fruit for this spin, nya?";
		if (select("Spin:Cancel") == 2) close;
		.@first_spin = 0;
	}
	if (countitem(6417) < 1) {
		mes "Mrr... You do not have any Silvervine Fruit left, nya.";
		close;
	}
	delitem 6417, 1;
	getitem .@id, 1;
	#COSTUME_ROULETTE_PITY = #COSTUME_ROULETTE_PITY + 1;
	mes "Mrrp~ You received ^0055FF" + getitemname(.@id) + "^000000, nya!";
	if (#COSTUME_ROULETTE_PITY >= 20) {
		#COSTUME_ROULETTE_PITY = 0;
		getitem 7051, 1;
		mes "Thank you, nya~ Silvervine was delicious! Here, take this ^0055FFSilk Mat^000000.";
		mes "My mama keeps knitting these for me, so I have lots. Please take one, nya~";
	}
	next;
	if (select("Spin again:Finish:Cancel") != 1) close;
	goto L_Spin;
}
